claims: Chile is officially the Republic of Chile.
Chile borders the Pacific Ocean to the west.
Chile borders the Andes Mountains to the east.
Chile has a population of 18.5 million in 2024.
Santiago is the capital of Chile.
The Atacama Desert is in the north of Chile.
The majority of Chile's population is Roman Catholic.
Chile has a significant and growing evangelical population.
Chilean culture is a blend of indigenous Mapuche and Spanish colonial influences.
Most of the population of Chile identifies as mestizo with mixed European and indigenous heritage.
Santiago is the largest city of Chile.
Santiago is home to nearly 40% of Chile's population.
Torres del Paine National Park is in Patagonia.
The Atacama Desert is known as the driest place on Earth.
Valparaíso is a historic port city.
Easter Island is also known as Rapa Nui.
Easter Island is famous for its Polynesian statues.
Chile is known as the world's longest country.
Chile is approximately 2,700 miles long.
Chile has a market-oriented economy.
Chile has a strong export sector including copper, fruit, and wine.
The U.S. State Department advises exercising increased caution due to potential civil unrest in Chile.
